verses.en: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
verses.pt: Nesse tempo Judá desceu de entre seus irmãos e entrou na casa dum adulamita, que se chamava Hira,
verses.en_web: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
verses.en_bbe: Now at that time, Judah went away from his brothers and became the friend of a man of Adullam named Hirah.

verses.en: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
verses.pt: e viu Judá ali a filha de um cananeu, que se chamava Suá; tomou-a por mulher, e esteve com ela.
verses.en_web: Judah saw there a certain Canaanite man named Shua’s daughter. He took her, and went in to her.
verses.en_bbe: And there he saw the daughter of a certain man of Canaan named Shua, and took her as his wife.

verses.en: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
verses.pt: Ela concebeu e teve um filho, e o pai chamou-lhe Er.
verses.en_web: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.
verses.en_bbe: And she gave birth to a son, and he gave him the name Er.

verses.en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
verses.pt: Tornou ela a conceber e teve um filho, a quem ela chamou Onã.
verses.en_web: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.
verses.en_bbe: And again she gave birth to a son, and he gave him the name Onan.

verses.en: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
verses.pt: Teve ainda mais um filho, e chamou-lhe Selá. Estava Judá em Quezibe, quando ela o teve.
verses.en_web: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bore him.
verses.en_bbe: Then she had another son, to whom she gave the name Shelah; she was at Chezib when the birth took place.

verses.en: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.
verses.pt: Depois Judá tomou para Er, o seu primogênito, uma mulher, por nome Tamar.
verses.en_web: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
verses.en_bbe: And Judah took a wife for his first son Er, and her name was Tamar.

verses.en: And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.
verses.pt: Ora, Er, o primogênito de Judá, era mau aos olhos do Senhor, pelo que o Senhor o matou.
verses.en_web: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight. Yahweh killed him.
verses.en_bbe: Now Er, Judah's first son, did evil in the eyes of the Lord, so that he put him to death.

verses.en: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
verses.pt: Então disse Judá a Onã: Toma a mulher de teu irmão, e cumprindo-lhe o dever de cunhado, suscita descendência a teu irmão.
verses.en_web: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Judah said to Onan, Go in to your brother's wife and do what it is right for a husband's brother to do; make her your wife and get offspring for your brother.

verses.en: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
verses.pt: Onã, porém, sabia que tal descendência não havia de ser para ele; de modo que, toda vez que se unia à mulher de seu irmão, derramava o sêmen no chão para não dar descendência a seu irmão.
verses.en_web: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled it on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.
verses.en_bbe: But Onan, seeing that the offspring would not be his, went in to his brother's wife, but let his seed go on to the earth, so that he might not get offspring for his brother.

verses.en: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.
verses.pt: E o que ele fazia era mau aos olhos do Senhor, pelo que o matou também a ele.
verses.en_web: The thing which he did was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and he killed him also.
verses.en_bbe: And what he did was evil in the eyes of the Lord, so that he put him to death, like his brother.

verses.en: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.
verses.pt: Então disse Judá a Tamar sua nora: Conserva-te viúva em casa de teu pai, até que Selá, meu filho, venha a ser homem; porquanto disse ele: Para que porventura não morra também este, como seus irmãos. Assim se foi Tamar e morou em casa de seu pai.
verses.en_web: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up”; for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.
verses.en_bbe: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, Go back to your father's house and keep yourself as a widow till my son Shelah becomes a man: for he had in his mind the thought that death might come to him as it had come to his brothers. So Tamar went back to her father's house.

verses.en: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah’s wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
verses.pt: Com o correr do tempo, morreu a filha de Suá, mulher de Judá. Depois de consolado, Judá subiu a Timnate para ir ter com os tosquiadores das suas ovelhas, ele e Hira seu amigo, o adulamita.
verses.en_web: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.
verses.en_bbe: And after a time, Bath-shua, Judah's wife, came to her end; and after Judah was comforted for her loss, he went to Timnah, where they were cutting the wool of his sheep, and his friend Hirah of Adullam went with him.

verses.en: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.
verses.pt: E deram aviso a Tamar, dizendo: Eis que o teu sogro sobe a Timnate para tosquiar as suas ovelhas.
verses.en_web: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
verses.en_bbe: And when Tamar had news that her father-in-law was going up to Timnah to the wool-cutting,

verses.en: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
verses.pt: Então ela se despiu dos vestidos da sua viuvez e se cobriu com o véu, e assim envolvida, assentou-se à porta de Enaim que está no caminho de Timnate; porque via que Selá já era homem, e ela lhe não fora dada por mulher.
verses.en_web: She took off her the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is by the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.
verses.en_bbe: She took off her widow's clothing, and covering herself with her veil, she took her seat near Enaim on the road to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was now a man, but she had not been made his wife.

verses.en: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.
verses.pt: Ao vê-la, Judá julgou que era uma prostituta, porque ela havia coberto o rosto.
verses.en_web: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
verses.en_bbe: When Judah saw her he took her to be a loose woman of the town, because her face was covered.

verses.en: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
verses.pt: E dirigiu-se para ela no caminho, e disse: Vem, deixa-me estar contigo; porquanto não sabia que era sua nora. Perguntou-lhe ela: Que me darás, para estares comigo?
verses.en_web: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”
verses.en_bbe: And turning to her by the roadside, he said to her, Let me come in to you; for he had no idea that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said, What will you give me as my price?

verses.en: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
verses.pt: Respondeu ele: Eu te enviarei um cabrito do rebanho. Perguntou ela ainda: Dar-me-ás um penhor até que o envies?
verses.en_web: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, I will give you a young goat from the flock. And she said, What will you give me as a sign till you send it?

verses.en: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
verses.pt: Então ele respondeu: Que penhor é o que te darei? Disse ela: O teu selo com a corda, e o cajado que está em tua mão. Ele, pois, lhos deu, e esteve com ela, e ela concebeu dele.
verses.en_web: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, What would you have? And she said, Your ring and its cord and the stick in your hand. So he gave them to her and went in to her, and she became with child by him.

verses.en: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
verses.pt: E ela se levantou e se foi; tirou de si o véu e vestiu os vestidos da sua viuvez.
verses.en_web: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
verses.en_bbe: Then she got up and went away and took off her veil and put on her widow's clothing.

verses.en: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.
verses.pt: Depois Judá enviou o cabrito por mão do seu amigo o adulamita, para receber o penhor da mão da mulher; porém ele não a encontrou.
verses.en_web: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.
verses.en_bbe: Then Judah sent his friend Hirah with the young goat, to get back the things which he had given as a sign to the woman: but she was not there.

verses.en: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.
verses.pt: Pelo que perguntou aos homens daquele lugar: Onde está a prostituta que estava em Enaim junto ao caminho? E disseram: Aqui não esteve prostituta alguma.
verses.en_web: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”
verses.en_bbe: And he put questions to the men of the place, saying, Where is the loose woman who was in Enaim by the wayside? And they said, There was no such woman there.

verses.en: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.
verses.pt: Voltou, pois, a Judá e disse: Não a achei; e também os homens daquele lugar disseram: Aqui não esteve prostituta alguma.
verses.en_web: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”
verses.en_bbe: So he went back to Judah, and said, I have not seen her, and the men of the place say that there is no such woman there.

verses.en: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
verses.pt: Então disse Judá: Deixa-a ficar com o penhor, para que não caiamos em desprezo; eis que enviei este cabrito, mas tu não a achaste.
verses.en_web: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”
verses.en_bbe: And Judah said, Let her keep the things, so that we may not be shamed; I sent the young goat, but you did not see the woman.

verses.en: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
verses.pt: Passados quase três meses, disseram a Judá: Tamar, tua nora, se prostituiu e eis que está grávida da sua prostituição. Então disse Judá: Tirai-a para fora, e seja ela queimada.
verses.en_web: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”
verses.en_bbe: Now about three months after this, word came to Judah that Tamar, his daughter-in-law, had been acting like a loose woman and was with child. And Judah said, Take her out and let her be burned.

verses.en: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
verses.pt: Quando ela estava sendo tirada para fora, mandou dizer a seu sogro: Do homem a quem pertencem estas coisas eu concebi. Disse mais: Reconhece, peço-te, de quem são estes, o selo com o cordão, e o cajado.
verses.en_web: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “By the man, whose these are, I am with child.” She also said, “Please discern whose are these—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”
verses.en_bbe: And while she was being taken out, she sent word to her father-in-law, saying, The man whose property these things are, is the father of my child: say then, whose are this ring and this cord and this stick?

verses.en: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
verses.pt: Reconheceu-os, pois, Judá, e disse: Ela é mais justa do que eu, porquanto não a dei a meu filho Selá. E nunca mais a conheceu.
verses.en_web: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.
verses.en_bbe: Then Judah said openly that they were his, and said, She is more upright than I am, for I did not give her to Shelah my son. And he had no more connection with her.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
verses.pt: Sucedeu que, ao tempo de ela dar à luz, havia gêmeos em seu ventre;
verses.en_web: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.
verses.en_bbe: And when the time came for her to give birth, it was clear that there were two children in her body.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first,
verses.pt: e dando ela à luz, um pôs fora a mão, e a parteira tomou um fio encarnado e o atou em sua mão, dizendo: Este saiu primeiro.
verses.en_web: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”
verses.en_bbe: And while she was in the act of giving birth, one of them put out his hand; and the woman who was with her put a red thread round his hand, saying, This one came out first.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.
verses.pt: Mas recolheu ele a mão, e eis que seu irmão saiu; pelo que ela disse: Como tens tu rompido! Portanto foi chamado Pérez.
verses.en_web: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.
verses.en_bbe: But then he took his hand back again, and his brother came first to birth: and the woman said, What an opening you have made for yourself! So he was named Perez.

verses.en: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
verses.pt: Depois saiu o seu irmão, em cuja mão estava o fio encamado; e foi chamado Zerá.
verses.en_web: Afterward his brother came out, that had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
verses.en_bbe: And then his brother came out, with the red thread round his hand, and he was named Zerah.
